x: We also had a match versus Met.Police at "The Warren" Hayes and in a field of eighteen Stan Vickers was first home in 56.05. R.D.McMullen was second and R.C.Hall third. Scoring eight a side we won with 43½ pts. to 93½.

Dave McMullen, by finishing second, gave a good indication of his ability over this distance and a newcomer to the distance, J.Keown put up a sterling performance, and with a little more experience should soon be among the top notchers.
The inaugeral R.W.A. 10 miles Championship at Sheffield in 1947 gave Harry another Championship at Sheffield in 1947 gave Harry another Championship win, and with Jack RUTLAND (2), R.D.
The club magazine of April 1940 reports that our walkers were having a successful time, in spite of losing a few men to the Services, and lists R.D.
